sections.heading: 1. Wake-up neck routine
lines: ① Lying down, do 10 small chin nods.
② Turn your head slowly, 5 each side.
③ Roll your shoulders back 10 times.
④ At night, set a 10-minute scroll timer.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…
lines: or you feel dizzy — stop and get advice.

slides.title: Still stiff after a few days?
slides.bubble:

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Late-night scrolling, stiff neck by morning? Mr Turtle knows the feeling.

The phone isn't really the problem. It's lying propped on a pillow with your chin tucked down for a long stretch. Necks cope with most positions, just not the same one for hours.

Try lifting the phone to eye level, lying on your side or sitting up with a pillow behind you, and shifting position every 10 minutes or so. In the morning, a few chin nods and slow head turns before getting up can help.

Pins and needles or weakness in the arm, dizziness or pain that keeps building is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 📱
